description: Pusat Registri Dataset Standar Riset & Tolok Ukur (Benchmarks) untuk Multimedia & Computer Vision Learning Hub

datasets.name: CIFAR-10
datasets.paperCitation: Krizhevsky, A. (2009). Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images. University of Toronto.
datasets.downloadInstructions: Unduh otomatis melalui torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10(root='./data', train=True, download=True) atau unduh berkas python binary dari situs resmi.
datasets.preprocessing: Normalisasi mean=[0.4914, 0.4822, 0.4465], std=[0.2470, 0.2435, 0.2616]; RandomCrop(32, padding=4), RandomHorizontalFlip().
datasets.evaluationProtocol: Top-1 Accuracy (%) pada 10.000 citra test set.

datasets.name: PASCAL VOC 2012
datasets.paperCitation: Everingham, M., et al. (2015). The Pascal Visual Object Classes Challenge: A Retrospective. IJCV, 111(1), 98-136.
datasets.downloadInstructions: Unduh arsip tar VOCtrainval_11-May-2012.tar (1.9 GB) dari situs Oxford University Robotics Group.
datasets.preprocessing: Resize menjaga aspek rasio, letterbox padding, normalisasi intensitas [0, 1] standar ImageNet.
datasets.evaluationProtocol: Mean Average Precision (mAP@0.5 IoU) untuk deteksi objek; mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) untuk segmentasi.

datasets.name: Microsoft Common Objects in Context (MS COCO 2017)
datasets.paperCitation: Lin, T.-Y., et al. (2014). Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context. ECCV 2014.
datasets.task: Object Detection, Instance Segmentation & Keypoint Estimation
datasets.downloadInstructions: Unduh berkas train2017.zip (19 GB), val2017.zip (1 GB), dan annotations_trainval2017.zip (241 MB) dari situs resmi cocodataset.org.
datasets.preprocessing: Resize citra ke resolusi masukan model (misal 640x640 untuk YOLOv8), normalisasi koordinat bounding box terpusat [x_center, y_center, width, height] relatif terhadap dimensi citra.
datasets.evaluationProtocol: mAP@[0.50:0.05:0.95], AP50, AP75, AP_small, AP_medium, AP_large.

datasets.name: Oxford-IIIT Pet Dataset
datasets.paperCitation: Parkhi, O. M., et al. (2012). Cats and Dogs. CVPR 2012.
classes: 37 ras kucing dan anjing (25 ras anjing, 12 ras kucing)
datasets.downloadInstructions: Unduh images.tar.gz (780 MB) dan annotations.tar.gz (19 MB) dari portal Oxford VGG.
datasets.preprocessing: Resize citra dan trimap ke 128x128 atau 256x256, label trimap {1: Foreground (hewan), 2: Background, 3: Boundary}.
datasets.evaluationProtocol: Pixel Accuracy dan Dice Coefficient / IoU kelas foreground.

datasets.name: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite (Stereo 2015 & Odometry)
datasets.paperCitation: Geiger, A., Lenz, P., & Urtasun, R. (2012). Are we ready for Autonomous Driving? The KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite. CVPR 2012.
datasets.task: Stereo Vision, Depth Estimation & Visual Odometry
datasets.downloadInstructions: Unduh stereo 2015 data_scene_flow.zip (2 GB) setelah registrasi akun akademik pada portal CVLibs Karlsruhe Institute of Technology.
datasets.preprocessing: Rektifikasi stereo berbasis matriks kalibrasi intrinsik dan ekstrinsik, normalisasi intensitas monokrom.
datasets.evaluationProtocol: D1-all error rate (% piksel dengan error disparitas > 3 px atau > 5%), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) estimasi jarak metrik.

datasets.name: OpenCV Standard Chessboard Calibration Pattern
datasets.paperCitation: Zhang, Z. (2000). A Flexible New Technique for Camera Calibration. IEEE TPAMI, 22(11), 1330-1334.
datasets.patternType: Pola Papan Catur 9x6 Titik Sudut Interior (Square size = 25 mm)
datasets.downloadInstructions: Disediakan secara terintegrasi pada modul Python OpenCV samples (left01.jpg .. left14.jpg) atau dihasilkan secara sintetis melalui generator citra proyektif.
datasets.preprocessing: Konversi ke Grayscale (cv2.cvtColor), deteksi titik sudut interior otomatis (cv2.findChessboardCorners), perbaikan sub-piksel (cv2.cornerSubPix).
datasets.evaluationProtocol: Mean Reprojection Error (piksel RMS < 0.5 px) dan kestabilan matriks intrinsik K.
